about_short_description.short_description: My Pet World is an app that provides that offers pet care, essential products to connecting with pet breeders

product.name: Pet Shop
product.description: An online platform within the app for purchasing pet food and accessories from various sellers.

product.name: Product Subscription
product.description: A recurring order service that allows pet owners to schedule regular deliveries of pet products.

product.name: Pet Profile
product.description: A feature to create and manage detailed profiles for pets, including health and care information.

product.name: Book Pet Services
product.description: An in-app service to book pet care services like grooming from various providers.

product.name: Socialize and Community Features
product.description: Tools within the app to connect pet owners, create events, share advice, and engage in discussions.

product.name: Find Your Gem (Lost Pet Alert)
product.description: A community alert system to report and locate lost pets by sharing information with local users.
